name: LOVE LOVE Robokko ~Sono Ko, Koutetsu!!~
original_name: LOVE LOVE ロボッ娘 ～その子、鋼鉄！！～
source:
You play as an ordinary salaryman whose father just passed away. He was obsessed with robots, and he has left three of them to play with them as you wish. However, you only have a week of fun until something happens... Will you pursue a mechanical love, or choose one of the three human girls that are interested in you?

[Based on [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=429&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演一名普通上班族，父親剛剛去世。他生前痴迷於機器人，並留下了三個機器人，任你隨心所欲地與它們相處。然而，在某件事情發生前，你只有一週的歡樂時光……你會追求機械之戀，還是從三名對你抱有好感的人類女性中選擇一人？

[改寫自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=429&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
